{{short description|American mathematician}}
{{about||the American graphic designer, artist and archivist|Elaine Lustig Cohen}}
'''Elaine Cohen''' (July 17, 1946 – October 19, 2025<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elaine Cohen Obituary - Millcreek, UT |url=https://www.dignitymemorial.com/obituaries/millcreek-ut/elaine-cohen-12569480 |access-date=29 October 2025 |website=Elaine Cohen Obituary - Millcreek, UT}}</ref>) was an American researcher in [[geometric modeling]] and [[computer graphics]], known for her pioneering research on [[B-spline]]s.{{r|ba}} She was a professor in the school of computing at the [[University of Utah]].{{r|profile}}

==Education and career==
Cohen graduated from [[Vassar College]] in 1968, with a bachelor's degree in mathematics. She went to [[Syracuse University]] for graduate study in mathematics, earning a master's degree in 1970 and completing her doctorate in 1974.{{r|educ}}
Her dissertation, ''On the Degree of Approximation of a Function by Partial Sums of its Fourier Series'', concerned [[approximation theory]], and was supervised by Daniel Waterman.{{r|mgp}}

At the University of Utah, Cohen became the first woman to gain tenure at the School of Engineering.{{r|ywca}}

==Contributions==
With Richard F. Riesenfeld and Gershon Elber, Cohen is the author of the book ''Geometric Modeling with Splines: An Introduction'' (AK Peters, 2001).{{r|gms}}

She has also contributed to the development of the [[Utah teapot]], improving it from a two-dimensional surface with no thickness to a bona-fide three-dimensional object.{{r|teapot}}

==Recognition==
In 2005, the [[YWCA]] of [[Salt Lake City]] gave Cohen their Outstanding Achievement Award.{{r|ywca}}
In 2009, Cohen and Riesenfeld were awarded the Pierre Bézier Award of the Solid Modeling Association for their work on B-splines in [[computer aided geometric design]].{{r|ba}}

== Memory ==
To honor her scientific and professional legacy, the ''Dr. Elaine Cohen Memorial Scholarship Fund'' was established through AnitaB.org to support women in technology.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr. Elaine Cohen Memorial Scholarship Fund |url=https://anitab.org/elaine-cohen-memorial-fund |access-date=29 October 2025 |website=Dr. Elaine Cohen Memorial Scholarship Fund}}</ref>
